description: This circular walk climbs to Margam Mountain in Neath Port Talbot. You can start the walk from the car park at Margam Country Park and then follow footpaths around the pretty lake towards the 19th century Margam Castle. The route then climbs steadily through woodland to Margam Mountain. The mountain reaches heights of 349 meters (roughly 1,145 feet), offering wonderful views to the coast at Margam sands and the surrounding countryside.On the way you can look out for wildlife including a variety of woodland birds and the park's resident deer.The area is also popular with mountain bikers with a range of trails through the forested area.
